purpose: Versioned scientific and technical thresholds for the Issue #6 test corpus. Thresholds are justified below and must not be loosened to make a run pass. Oracle-vs-candidate comparisons are diagnostic only unless a threshold is explicitly listed as a parity gate.

analytic_advection_east_m.justification: 1% of the 36000 m signal. Uniform-wind Petterssen advection is exact up to f32 rounding; the bound is generous by design.

analytic_advection_north_m.justification: No cross-wind component; any north/south drift is numerical noise.

analytic_advection_vertical_m.justification: No vertical wind; vertical position must be unchanged up to f32 rounding.

mass_conservation_rel.justification: f32 summation-order differences between CPU/GPU paths with deposition disabled. No mass may be created or destroyed.

deposition_cpu_abs.justification: Accumulated f32-vs-f64 error over 12 exponential-decay steps (existing D-06 budget).

deposition_gpu_abs.justification: Additional adapter/driver exp() variation on top of the CPU budget (existing D-06 budget).

langevin_variance_rel.justification: Sample variance over 16384 draws has relative standard error ~1.1%; 5% is about 4.5 sigma.

pbl_confinement_margin_m.justification: Hard PBL reflection tolerance for the candidate; the Fortran oracle uses a soft top and may place particles above.

oracle_parity_note: No oracle-vs-candidate concentration or spread threshold is versioned as a pass/fail gate in this corpus. Oracle comparisons report mass, center of mass, covariance/eigenvalues, vertical quantiles, overlap, field correlation and process budgets diagnostically. Any future parity gate needs a separately versioned threshold with physical justification.
